# Swindoo 0.1.8
This visual-feedback update adds calm, optional motion to Swindoo's cursor-adjacent action HUD.
- Animate each preview and confirmation in the command direction without delaying or animating the window action itself. - Compress the minimize symbol toward the Dock, expand the maximize symbol, and nudge half-screen confirmations left or right. - Add a persistent “Show Animations” checkbox to the menu bar menu, enabled by default. - Disable all HUD motion when the preference is off or macOS Reduce Motion is active, while preserving immediate visual feedback.

# Swindoo 0.1.7
This compatibility update extends Finder's measured-toolbar behavior to other macOS apps that expose the same native Accessibility structure.
- Recognize a real top-edge `AXToolbar` automatically across AppKit, SwiftUI, and compatible macOS windows. - Start two-finger gestures over controls inside that measured toolbar, including Safari-style unified window controls. - Keep ordinary clicks unchanged and retain the standard title-bar path without additional Accessibility traversal. - Continue rejecting content toolbars, interactive content below the window chrome, dialogs, overlays, and windows without valid title-bar evidence.

# Swindoo 0.1.6
This Finder compatibility update makes the complete unified toolbar available as a gesture start surface.
- Start two-finger gestures over Finder's view, grouping, share, tag, action, Dropbox, and search controls. - Keep ordinary clicks on Finder toolbar controls unchanged. - Restrict this exception to Finder's measured top toolbar; interactive content below it and controls in other apps remain excluded. - Discover nested Finder toolbar accessibility elements with bounded traversal for compatibility across macOS window layouts.

# Swindoo 0.1.5
This compatibility update adds reliable gestures across Finder's unified title and toolbar surface.
- Use Finder's measured Accessibility toolbar frame instead of a fixed enlarged gesture zone. - Accept the full noninteractive Finder toolbar surface while keeping search, view, share, action, and other controls excluded. - Reject content toolbars and preserve the default title-bar boundary for every other app. - Retain the existing bundle identifier, Accessibility identity, and Sparkle update channel for seamless in-place updates.

# Swindoo 0.1.4
This compatibility update adds reliable title-bar gestures for the current native WhatsApp app on macOS.
- Recognize WhatsApp's Catalyst contact-header surface as a valid gesture area. - Keep call, video, menu and other interactive WhatsApp controls excluded from window gestures. - Support the taller custom WhatsApp title bar while preserving the normal geometric title-bar boundary. - Retain the existing bundle identifier, Accessibility identity and Sparkle update channel for seamless in-place updates.

# Swindoo 0.1.3
This transition release introduces the new Swindoo name while preserving the technical identity used by existing installations.
- Rename the visible app, menu, onboarding and gesture guide to Swindoo. - Keep the existing bundle identifier, executable, preferences and Sparkle feed so Accessibility permission and in-place updates can continue. - Update the English and German app copy for the new brand. - Refresh the website, documentation, legal drafts and release presentation in English, German and French. - Retain the window-compatibility improvements introduced in version 0.1.2.

# EasySwipe 0.1.2
This compatibility update broadens title-bar gesture support across native and custom macOS windows, including Notion and other Electron- or Chromium-based apps.
- Recognize noninteractive web, toolbar, tab-group, list, and scroll containers as valid parts of a custom title bar. - Walk deeper Accessibility hierarchies while still blocking real buttons, tabs, fields, selectable rows, and custom controls with activation actions. - Ignore sheets, popovers, menus, tooltips, system dialogs, and borderless overlays that do not provide a dependable title bar. - Support titled dialog and utility windows when they expose valid macOS title-bar semantics. - Respect application-enforced minimum, maximum, and fixed window sizes while preserving successful position or size changes. - Keep full-height left, right, and maximize placement across usable display areas.

# EasySwipe 0.1.1
This maintenance update makes left- and right-half gestures more reliable across displays, display scaling modes, and applications with custom Accessibility behavior.
- Apply window size before and after positioning so macOS cannot retain a constrained height from the previous display. - Work around `AXEnhancedUserInterface` while resizing affected applications. - Verify that a window reached the complete requested frame and perform one bounded correction when needed. - Preserve the full usable vertical screen height for left, right, and maximize gestures.

# EasySwipe 0.1.0
The first public EasySwipe release brings fast title-bar window gestures to macOS.
- Swipe left or right to fill the corresponding screen half. - Swipe down to minimize the window. - Swipe up to maximize within the usable desktop area without entering full screen. - See immediate cursor-adjacent visual feedback while swiping. - Use a trackpad, Magic Trackpad, or Apple Magic Mouse. - Run entirely from the menu bar with English and German localization. - Keep Accessibility permission across signed updates. - Receive signed in-app updates through Sparkle.
